title: SLASH · The registration
venue: Box 4B · sixty pages · never lettered for print
logline: The photograph's back: a boat's registration number and a home port the framer has never heard of — GRAUSTARK, LA — in a hand that isn't the woman's. He measures the back as told and copies the number onto his cuff.

panels.composition: Full page: the photograph's back filling the top two-thirds, a registration number and a port name in pen; below, the framer's cuff with the number copied onto it in ballpoint, the mat cutter's blade beside his wrist.

image.prompt: black and white noir comic page, brush-pen over blue pencil, rain as dense vertical hatching, stark black spotting, the blank back of a photograph filling most of the page with a handwritten registration number and a port name, and below it a man's shirt cuff with the same number copied in ballpoint beside a mat cutter's blade
image.notes: Graustark, LA: Vol 5's town. The page never says what it is. Letter the number after; the port name stays a shape.

art.line: brush-pen over rough blue pencil; rain in frantic vertical hatching; stark spotting; Arc 1's aesthetic pushed to noir
art.palette: black and white; one gray wash for the wet

notes: A port he's never heard of.
layout: two panels, top two-thirds and bottom third
